title: Culture Conversion Non-Inferiority at Month 6

schemaFields.scientificObjective: Establish non-inferiority of the 9-month levofloxacin regimen versus the standard 12-month regimen on the primary efficacy endpoint (culture conversion at month 6)
schemaFields.coreScientificMessage: Culture conversion at month 6 was 92.3% vs 91.8% — a +0.5 pp difference (95% CI −3.1 to +4.2), well within the pre-specified 5-pp non-inferiority margin
supportingEvidence: MRC Working Party 1998 historical NI margin justification
schemaFields.contextLimitationsFairBalance: NI margin of 5 pp is justified by MRC 1998 historical data. Does NOT apply to rifampicin-resistant strains, HIV co-infection with CD4<100, or paediatric patients <12 years. Higher Grade 3+ hepatotoxicity signal in the 9-month arm (2.1% vs 1.4%) requires monthly LFT monitoring — see card TB-SAF-001.

schemaFields.contextLimitationsFairBalance: Adherence and cost-benefit projections are based on the SPINE-TB-2 trial population. Efficacy non-inferiority result (TB-EFF-001) is the direct evidence; the adherence/cost claim is an inference. Not appropriate for individual patient counselling.
